in: AGENTS.md: a `Recommendations` entry in the pattern language (command header, row format, borders, fonts, source link, empty state, reduced-motion, accessibility).
AGENTS.md: identity-data bullet for `(features)/recommendations/recommendations-data.ts` with its typed fields and truthfulness rule.
AGENTS.md: command-per-surface list, `SIDEBAR_MENU` nav item, interactive-shell section list, generation recipe step, and removal of the `/recommendations not yet themed` omission.

codebaseEvidence.reason: Source of truth for the design system. 'Known deliberate omissions' lists `/recommendations` as the last unthemed route; the pattern language, identity-data list, command-per-surface list, recipe and consistency invariants are the sections the new page must be added to. Its non-negotiable rules (one accent, no logos/icon grids, mono vs sans, sharp corners, dashed = text lists, reduced-motion, true claims only) fully constrain the page.

States the repo is 'harness-first' with no reference code; lists the identity-data files a user edits (table under Quick start) and the feature bullets — both must mention the new data file/page to stay consistent with AGENTS.md.
Generation prompt; step 8 'remaining pages, one per response' already covers additional routes, so no edit is needed.
Contains only `@AGENTS.md`; confirms AGENTS.md is the single file to edit (never two places).

decisions.summary: Interpret 'add testimonial page' as adding the page's pattern to the harness (AGENTS.md + README), not as writing Next.js code. The repository tracks only AGENTS.md, CLAUDE-import.md, README.md and prompt; there is no app to add a route to. The live reference site (xandremicua.vercel.app/recommendations, fetched 2026-11-03) shows a 'Coming Soon' stub, confirming the page is undesigned rather than merely unthemed.
evidence: git ls-files output: 4 tracked files, no package.json

decisions.summary: Route and vocabulary are `/recommendations` (nav label `recommendations`, data file `recommendations-data.ts`, type `Recommendation`), not `/testimonials`. The harness, the reference site's nav and the omission note already use `recommendations`; a second word would create exactly the naming drift the consistency invariants forbid. README may use 'testimonials' once as a plain-English synonym in prose.
evidence: Reference site nav: Projects, Blog, Stack, Experience, Trading, Recommendations

decisions.summary: Page idiom: command header `cat recommendations/*.md`; each entry is a dashed-bordered raised block (dashed = text lists, solid = projects) with a mono attribution line `{name}  {role} @ {company}` in text-primary/text-secondary, a hand-built `yyyy-mm` date right-aligned in text-secondary, the quote in `font-sans` text-primary, and an optional source rendered as a `# via {label}` comment-style external link (accent-muted `#`, link accent-muted → accent). No images, no ratings, no carousel. Empty state: `cat: recommendations/*.md: No such file or directory`.
evidence: AGENTS.md › The pattern language › Command header, List rows, Markdown (# comments in accent-muted), Filter pills (empty states speak shell)

decisions.summary: Truthfulness rule for the data file: entries must be real, quoted verbatim, and published with the author's permission; `source` links to where the recommendation is publicly visible when one exists. Mirrors the ticker's 'only TRUE claims' rule.
evidence: AGENTS.md › Identity data › Ticker STATS (TRUE claims)
AGENTS.md rule 10 (copy is part of the design)

decisions.summary: No new homepage section and no ticker stat; the page is reached via the nav item (last, after `trading`), the 404 route tree (derived from SIDEBAR_MENU automatically) and the interactive shell's section commands.
evidence: AGENTS.md › Generation recipe step 6 (fixed homepage order)
AGENTS.md › 404 (tree of real routes from SIDEBAR_MENU)
AGENTS.md › Interactive shell (commands that name a section router.push)

decisions.summary: No ADR is authored: the repository has no docs/adr directory or accepted ADRs, only an unused `.specify/templates/adr-template.md`; AGENTS.md itself is where design decisions are recorded.

openQuestions.question: Confirm the interpretation in D001: the deliverable is the harness pattern (AGENTS.md + README), because this branch has no application code. If you instead want the full Next.js reference implementation generated with a testimonials page, that is a separate, much larger request requiring identity data (name, handle, bio, links, palette) and should be started as its own feature.

D002 keeps the route name `/recommendations` for continuity with the harness and the reference site. Say so at handoff if you prefer `/testimonials` everywhere instead; the plan then applies with the word swapped (route, nav label, data file, type, command header).

tasks.title: Specify the recommendations page in AGENTS.md
tasks.description: Add the `/recommendations` page to the harness so it is generated and themed like every other route. Edits, all inside AGENTS.md: (1) under 'Identity data', add a bullet for `(features)/recommendations/recommendations-data.ts` exporting `Recommendation[]` with fields `{ name, role, company?, quote, date?: "yyyy-mm", source?: { label, url } }`, newest first, and the D004 truthfulness rule; (2) in 'Command header › Commands per surface', add `recommendations \`cat recommendations/*.md\``; (3) add a new '### Recommendations = cat quotes' subsection to 'The pattern language' implementing D003 — dashed-bordered raised block per entry, mono attribution line, hand-built `yyyy-mm` date (never Date.toString), `font-sans` quote, `# via {label}` external source link with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and an `aria-label`, explicit 'no headshots, no logos, no ratings, no carousel, no truncation of quotes' line, shell-speaking empty state, static render under reduced motion (Container fade-up only); (4) in 'Appbar `SIDEBAR_MENU`' identity bullet and recipe step 4, note `recommendations` as the last nav item after `trading`; (5) in 'Interactive shell', list `recommendations` among section commands; (6) add a recipe step after step 7 ('Pages per the pattern language') naming the recommendations page, or extend step 7's sentence — one mention, no duplication; (7) delete the `/recommendations not yet themed` line from 'Known deliberate omissions' (keep the OG-image line and the closing sentence). Do not change the token block, rules 1–10, or any existing pattern's wording.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-T001-1: `grep -n 'cat recommendations/\*.md' AGENTS.md` matches at least twice (commands-per-surface list and the new pattern subsection).

AC-T001-2: `grep -n 'recommendations-data.ts' AGENTS.md` matches in the Identity data section and the bullet documents fields name, role, company?, quote, date? ("yyyy-mm"), source? { label, url } and the real/verbatim/permissioned rule.

AC-T001-3: AGENTS.md contains a `### Recommendations` subsection inside 'The pattern language' that names: dashed border, raised background token (`secondary-background`), mono attribution, `font-sans` quote, `yyyy-mm` date built by hand, `# via {label}` source link in accent-muted → accent, empty state text `cat: recommendations/*.md: No such file or directory`, and an explicit prohibition on headshots/logos/ratings/carousels.
AC-T001-4: `grep -n 'not yet themed' AGENTS.md` returns no matches; the OG-image omission and 'Nothing else should be added without a fight.' remain.
AC-T001-5: `grep -n '/testimonials' AGENTS.md` returns no matches (naming per D002).

AC-T001-6: Every color named in the new subsection is an existing token (`background`, `secondary-background`, `border`, `secondary-border`, `text-primary`, `text-secondary`, `accent`, `accent-muted`); `grep -n 'neutral-\|#[0-9a-fA-F]\{6\}' ` over the new subsection's lines returns nothing new, and no `rounded-*` appears in it.
AC-T001-7: `git diff --stat` for the task touches only AGENTS.md, and `git diff` shows no modified lines inside the `:root` token block or the 'Non-negotiable rules' list.

The deliverable is harness text, which is itself the design-system document; a design pass would produce mocks for code that does not exist on this branch.
